_readme: THE MUSIC BANK (ELEMENTS.md §3, 2026-09-23). One row per file. A brief's `music: {energy, tempo_bpm, mood}` is picked by machine/banks.py: energy and mood exact, then the nearest tempo within tempo_tolerance_bpm, then the id — the same tags pick the same track every time. `{bank_id, file}` is written into plan.json; the edit ducks it 18 dB under the voice and cuts it to the beat.
`file` is the Drive path of the made audio, under Shared Assets/banks/music/. Rows marked "to make" are the target list: machine/make_bank.py --bank music --dry-run shows each request and its cost.
